name: Piedmont (Rock Creek Park, Washington DC, mid-autumn)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Rock Creek Park Golf: an upland Piedmont hardwood course in mid-autumn (developer, 2026-10-22: 'piedmont theme with mid autumn'). Not the riverside potomac (cherries) or the marshy anacostia: cool-season turf still green, a shade cooler than late summer; tan local sand; a brown-grey creek over stones; asphalt paths. F0-F2 are leaf litter on the forest floor (woods and the woods outside the course), shown between the crowns. Trees in assets-src/trees_piedmont.py: tulip poplars (the lidar's narrow-crown class), oaks, red and sugar maples and beech, about four in ten showing autumn colour. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
